title: Encouraging Employers and Employees to Shift to Portable Medical Benefits
what_it_is: Encouraging Employers and Employees to Shift to Portable Medical Benefits

sections.label: Survey, MediShield Life introduction
sections.summary: A 2013 survey showed about 4% of companies employing about 20% of local workers do so, and MediShield Life gave all Singaporeans portable medical insurance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Our last survey in 2013 showed that about 4% of companies employing about 20% of our local workers do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: With the introduction of MediShield Life in 2015, all Singaporeans now have portable medical insurance.

sections.label: Portable coverage under MediShield Life
sections.summary: MediShield Life assures local workers their medical coverage, including for pre-existing illnesses, follows them regardless of employment status or employer changes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: With MediShield Life, all our local workers can be assured that their medical coverage, including for pre-existing illnesses, would follow them, regardless of any change in employment status or employer.

sections.label: Tax deduction up to 2%
sections.summary: The tax deduction can be up to 2% of the payroll instead of 1%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: For example, the tax deduction can be up to 2% of the payroll, instead of 1%.

sections.label: MediShield Life and portable schemes
sections.summary: MediShield Life provides a medical safety net for everyone and their families, so tripartite partners encourage employers to move to portable schemes building on it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: From that viewpoint, I can understand why most employers would not offer this individual option.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: But more importantly, Mdm Speaker, I would like to highlight that Singapore has a feature which is quite different from most other countries, which is MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: MediShield Life provides that medical safety net for everyone, not just the workers, but also their families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: This is the reason why the tripartite partners have decided to channel our energy to encourage companies, employers to move from non-portable schemes to a portable scheme, but building on MediShield Life.

sections.label: Outpatient treatment under MediShield Life
sections.summary: Longer-term expensive outpatient treatments such as dialysis and cancer treatment are covered under MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: How are they going to pay for them without portable insurance?

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: However, to my understanding, and the Minister for Health can correct me if I am wrong, for outpatient treatments which are longer term and expensive, such as dialysis and cancer treatment, they are covered under the MediShield Life.

sections.label: Awareness promotion and education
sections.summary: Awareness promotion and education need to be stepped up for both employers and employees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Yes, we need to step up awareness promotion and education, both for the employers and the employees.
